Package neqsim.process.equipment.reservoir

Class InflowControlDevice.Mixture

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.reservoir.InflowControlDevice.Mixture
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
InflowControlDevice
public static final class InflowControlDevice.Mixture extends Object implements Serializable
In-situ fluid mixture entering a device: phase properties and volume fractions.

Density is the volume-weighted mean. Viscosity is the volume-weighted mean of the natural logarithm of the phase viscosities, which keeps a small water or gas fraction from being swamped by the oil value.

      public Mixture(double oilDensity, double waterDensity, double gasDensity, double oilViscosity, double waterViscosity, double gasViscosity, double waterFraction, double gasFraction)
      Creates a mixture.
      Parameters:
      oilDensity - oil density [kg/m3]
      waterDensity - water density [kg/m3]
      gasDensity - gas density at downhole conditions [kg/m3]
      oilViscosity - oil viscosity [Pa s]
      waterViscosity - water viscosity [Pa s]
      gasViscosity - gas viscosity [Pa s]
      waterFraction - water volume fraction of the in-situ flow [-]
      gasFraction - gas volume fraction of the in-situ flow [-]
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a density or viscosity is not positive, a fraction is negative, or the fractions sum to more than one
